old:
**C30 Psychoid Number** depends upon this field as a guardrail. Numerical, geometric or archetypal correspondences may be philosophically fertile while remaining only operational analogy until independent evidence raises their standing. Cross-domain recurrence is never a covert proof of common cause or common descent.

Here “raises their standing” concerns an additional historical or empirical claim, not a ladder on which operational homology must climb to become legitimate. [C30 — Psychoid Number](../../concepts/C30-Psychoid-Number.md) **defines** an Offered inquiry into the efficacy of number across psychic and physical descriptions. Its formal identities remain exact; its historically situated Jung–Pauli questions remain source-specific; its computational extension must show what changes in an apparatus. Evidence for one office cannot silently settle another. The inquiry's value lies in the discriminating work it makes possible.
new:
[Psychoid Number](../../concepts/C30-Psychoid-Number.md) **defines** an inquiry into the efficacy of number across psychic and physical descriptions. A formal identity gives an exact relation between specified mathematical objects. The historically situated Jung–Pauli inquiry brings particular speakers, images and questions into that field. A computational extension asks what changes in an apparatus. Each can give the others a more exact question through the difference of what it establishes.

Operational homology establishes the correspondence actually demonstrated: what is transformed, preserved, generated or returned in each field. Its force belongs to that achieved relation. An additional claim about common cause or historical descent asks a further question and needs evidence capable of answering it. The comparative operation already changes what can be seen and investigated; it can also disclose where the terms cease to correspond and return that difference to the next inquiry.
review_reason: Recover homology’s own positive warrant. Replace the self-contradictory “only analogy until its standing rises / not a ladder” construction with the precise formal, historical and technical offices, and the correspondence the comparison itself establishes.
